_comment: Ozow's documented POST variables and their maximum lengths, transcribed from https://ozow.com/integrations (fetched via Alembic 2026-10-14). This table is the oracle for contracts/checks/vendor-stand-return-url/check-ozow-field-limits.mjs and must equal OZOW_FIELD_MAX_LENGTH in lib/payments/gateway-field-limits.ts. Every name in OZOW_OUTBOUND_FIELD_ORDER plus HashCheck MUST have an entry, so a field added later cannot escape the length check.

notes.Amount: Documented as Decimal (9,2): at most 9 digits plus the decimal point = 10 characters.
notes.CancelUrl: Ozow's main post-variable table prints CancelUrl as String (50) while ErrorUrl, SuccessUrl and NotifyUrl are String (150) and another table differs. DECISION (orchestrator, 2026-10-14): CancelUrl is enforced at 150. Evidence: learned.md and docs/payment-seam.md (F3/F4 live-purchase testing, line ~253) record live Ozow sandbox ticket purchases reaching `paid` while sending the 63-68 char ticket CancelUrl (https://saoc.co.za/tickets/cancelled?ref=SAOC-2027-xxxxxxxxxxxx; 68 on beta), so Ozow does not enforce 50. lib/payments/ozow.ts maps cancelUrl to both CancelUrl and ErrorUrl, so one URL feeds both. The /vsp alias is kept anyway: short URLs add margin and cost nothing.
